mechanism_narrative: A sustained 6-month decline in the federal funds rate compresses discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as monetary policy easing supports risk asset performance.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where FEDFUNDS has declined for 6 months.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 5.0% in a 3-month window, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts decline below 900 thousand units and consumer price inflation exceeds 2.5% annually, it indicates a contraction in consumer demand and rising inflation that together cause negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where HOUST < 900 and CPIAUCSL > 2.5.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a decline in residential construction below 900 thousand units signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances during late-cycle expansion when HOUST falls below 900.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production below 95.0 for 3 months indicates weakening economic activity, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as manufacturing slowdowns reduce corporate earnings growth.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 40% of instances where INDPRO remains below 95.0 for 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 3.0% and consumer price inflation is above 2.0%, it signals a tightening monetary cycle that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 3.0 and CPIAUCSL > 2.0.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-unemployment regime, a decline in non-farm payrolls below 135 million signals worsening labor market conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when PAYEMS < 135000 and UNRATE > 6.0.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 6-month increase in residential sales (RSAFS) above 420,000 million dollars signals strong consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days through elevated consumption growth.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where RSAFS has increased for 6 months.
